algorithm: Perform a BFS starting from vertex 0
Count the number of visited vertices during BFS
Compare count to n: if equal, graph is connected; else disconnected
constraints: BFS must be used for traversal
edge_cases: n=1 (single node with no edges): returns True
n>1 with no edges: returns False
n>1 with all vertices isolated: returns False
inputs: n: integer >= 1; edges: list of distinct [u,v] pairs where 0<=u<v<n
output: bool: True if the graph is connected, False otherwise
purpose: Determine if an undirected graph with n vertices (labeled 0 to n-1) and given edges is connected
